## FAQs

We have gathered answers to common questions to help pet owners in Northeast Dallas learn about our mobile grooming services, the choices offered, and what to expect.

What types of pets do you groom?

We primarily groom dogs and cats of all breeds, sizes, and ages — including seniors and special-needs pets. If you have a different animal in mind, reach out — we’re happy to talk!

Do I need to be home during the appointment?

Yes, we ask that a pet parent or guardian is home at the beginning of the appointment to greet the groomer and your pet. After that, you’re free to relax — we’ll take it from there!

Do you need access to my water or electricity?

Nope! Our mobile grooming vans are fully self-contained with their own water supply and power system. You don’t need to provide a thing — just your pet.

How long does grooming take?

Most appointments last between 1 to 2 hours, depending on the size, breed, and condition of your pet’s coat. Every groom is one-on-one, so your pet has our full attention from start to finish.

Do you use cages or crate dryers?

Never. All grooming takes place in a quiet, cage-free environment — just one pet, one groomer, and lots of gentle care.

What’s included in a grooming appointment?

Our packages are customized, but most include a bath, brush-out, haircut (if needed), nail trim, ear cleaning, and plenty of tail wags. We’ll go over the details with you before we begin.

What if my pet is anxious or doesn’t usually like grooming?

You’re not alone — and we’re here to help. Our groomers are trained in calm handling and animal behavior, and we take our time to build trust with every pet.

We serve neighborhoods and cities in the Northeast Dallas area. From large dogs in the suburbs to pampered pets in the city, we bring calm, clean mobile pet grooming care to your curb.
